description: First draft for mod-copycat using RMB 36.0.0. Values come from the existing ModuleDescriptor and RMB defaults; they have not been verified against the Bugfest baseline (3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants). Null values require deployment-specific input or indicate no recommended override; see each description. Schema validation is pending.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU allocation recommendation is pending deployment baseline verification.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory limit in MiB, converted from the existing ModuleDescriptor limit of 536870912 bytes.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation recommendation is pending deployment baseline verification.

java.name: MaxRAMPercentage
java.description: Maximum heap as a percentage of available memory, matching the existing JAVA_OPTIONS setting.

deployment.description: Supports multiple module instances for high availability. Recommended replica count remains undetermined pending deployment baseline verification.

kong.description: No module-specific Kong timeout recommendation has been established. Retain deployment defaults pending verification.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options passed by the container launcher, matching the existing ModuleDescriptor. Expresses the same setting documented in the java section.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL writer hostname supplied by the deployment.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL writer port, matching the existing ModuleDescriptor.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name supplied by the deployment.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL administrative username supplied by the deployment.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL administrative password supplied through deployment secret management.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional synchronous PostgreSQL reader hostname. Set together with DB_PORT_READER; otherwise RMB uses the writer.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional synchronous PostgreSQL reader port. Set together with DB_HOST_READER; otherwise RMB uses the writer.

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate or certificate chain used to verify the PostgreSQL server. When set, RMB requires TLSv1.3 and hostname verification; when unset, RMB uses an unencrypted connection.

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Query timeout in milliseconds, retained from the existing ModuleDescriptor. RMB defaults to 0 (disabled). Only takes effect when code passes the configured timeout to query methods; mod-copycat does not explicitly do so.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant per database pool in each module instance. Matches the existing ModuleDescriptor; RMB's default is 4.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Leave unset. RMB 36.0.0 documents shared pooling as buggy (RMB-1030). Setting this enables pooling shared across tenants and overrides DB_MAXPOOLSIZE.

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle connection timeout in milliseconds, matching RMB's default. 0 keeps idle connections open indefinitely.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum connection lifetime in milliseconds, matching RMB 36.0.0's default of 30 minutes. Expired connections close when idle; 0 means unlimited.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries after a database connection attempt fails. Reconnection is disabled by default.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Delay between database reconnection attempts in milliseconds. Leave unset to use the underlying Vert.x default; relevant only when reconnection is enabled.

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Threshold in milliseconds for EXPLAIN ANALYZE diagnostics on supported RMB query methods, matching RMB's default. Diagnostics execute the query again; a high threshold effectively disables them.

EnvVars.name: DB_ALLOW_SUPPRESS_OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING
EnvVars.description: Optional expiry timestamp for optimistic-lock suppression in RMB. Leave unset: mod-copycat's profile table does not enable failOnConflictUnlessSuppressed.
